    std::string s;
    std::getline(std::cin, s);

    int res = 0;
    if (s.length() > 1) {
        int n = s.length();
        int i = 0;
        while (i < n) {
            int j = i + 1;
            while (j < n && s[j] == s[j - 1]) {
                j++;
            }
            if (((j - i) & 1) == 0) {
                res++;
            }
            i = j;
        }
    }
    std::cout << res << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
